gloss: to turn, to revolve, to go around

definitions.gloss: to turn, to revolve, to rotate
definitions.explanation: To move in a circular motion around an axis or center point.

definitions.gloss: to go around, to make the rounds
definitions.explanation: To visit multiple places in sequence, to circulate.
For something to spread throughout or circulate (rumors, effects, etc.).

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}は{太陽|たいよう}の{周|まわ}りを{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The Earth revolves around the sun.

examples.japanese: {観光|かんこう}バスで{町|まち}を{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: I went around the town on a sightseeing bus.

examples.japanese: お{酒|さけ}が{回|まわ}ってきた。
examples.english: The alcohol is starting to take effect.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair verb: {回|まわ}す (transitive, to turn something).

CONJUGATION (godan): {回|まわ}る → {回|まわ}らない → {回|まわ}った → {回|まわ}って

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{回|まわ}る (go around ~)
- 〜の{周|まわ}りを{回|まわ}る (revolve around ~)
- {順番|じゅんばん}に{回|まわ}る (go around in order)
- {右|みぎ}/{左|ひだり}に{回|まわ}る (turn right/left)

IDIOMS:
- {頭|あたま}が{回|まわ}る (to be quick-witted)
- {手|て}が{回|まわ}る (to have time to deal with)
- お{鉢|はち}が{回|まわ}る (one's turn comes around)
